The '''World thrasher''' was a massive armored vehicle developed by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Capable of uprooting or incinerating trees, smashing boulders, flattening hills, and even burrowing through mountains, World Thrashers were used to clear a path for incoming ground troops during planetary invasions. Though slow and ponderous, they were nevertheless extremely effective at their job. A large number of World Thrashers were deployed during the [[Assault on Odessen]] in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
World thrashers appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during "Chapter VIII: End Times."
